title: Early Diagnosis of Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence: A Large Tabular Model Approach with Structured and Unstructured clinical data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating predictive model performance (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-score, MCC, and AUC) across separate male and female patient cohorts to identify disparities in prediction quality.
Assessing the performance of predictive models and clinical scoring systems on a specific age subgroup (patients under 75 years old) to evaluate how age distributions impact predictive reliability.
